en_title: Which Ghost Rider Is Ryan Gosling Playing in the MCU? | Comic Con 2026
cn_title: 瑞恩·高斯林饰演哪一版MCU恶灵骑士？
subtitle: 复仇之灵身份成谜

paragraphs.en: Start your engines, Marvel fans, because Ghost Rider is coming back to the big screen. Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige started off the company’s SDCC panel this weekend with a major announcement: Ryan Gosling will play the MCU’s Ghost Rider. The new film featuring the Spirit of Vengeance will be directed by Shawn Levy of Deadpool & Wolverine fame, and is set to be released in 2028. Suffice to say, this is a huge deal for the MCU, given Gosling’s star power and the fact that Ghost Rider hasn’t been seen in a movie since 2011’s ignominious Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance, the second Ghost Rider film starring Nicolas Cage.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威粉丝们，发动引擎吧，恶灵骑士即将重返大银幕。漫威影业总裁凯文·费奇在本周末的SDCC发布会上率先抛出重磅消息：瑞恩·高斯林将饰演MCU的恶灵骑士。这部以复仇之灵为主角的新片由《死侍与金刚狼》导演肖恩·利维执导，计划于2028年上映。凭借高斯林的明星号召力，再考虑到恶灵骑士自2011年口碑惨淡的《灵魂战车2：复仇时刻》——尼古拉斯·凯奇主演的第二部恶灵骑士电影——之后便再未登上大银幕，这无疑是MCU的一件大事。

paragraphs.en: But some big questions weren’t answered at the panel. Namely: which Ghost Rider is Gosling playing? Because there’s more than one (there’s actually quite a few ), although the obvious option is Johnny Blaze. However, the fact that Gosling’s character wasn’t confirmed does raise our eyebrows and makes us wonder if perhaps Marvel is going for a left-field choice. Let’s take a look at the comics and delve into the possibilities for the MCU’s Ghost Rider.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，发布会没有回答几个重要问题，其中最关键的是：高斯林究竟饰演哪一位恶灵骑士？恶灵骑士并不只有一个——实际上版本相当多——最显而易见的选择当然是约翰尼·布雷泽。但官方没有确认角色身份，难免让人怀疑漫威是否准备作出意料之外的选择。下面就从漫画出发，分析MCU恶灵骑士的各种可能。

paragraphs.en: Although Johnny Blaze is not technically the first character named Ghost Rider to appear in the comics (that honor goes to Carter Slade, a vigilante in the Old West who was later renamed the Phantom Rider), he is the most prominent. Blaze had a solo comic in the 1970s that ran for 80 issues, and would remain a recurring figure in the Marvel universe ever since, even as other Ghost Riders entered the fray. He was also adapted in the aforementioned pair of Nicolas Cage films, and has made numerous appearances in Marvel video games .
paragraphs.cn: 严格来说，约翰尼·布雷泽并不是漫画中第一位名为恶灵骑士的角色——这项荣誉属于旧西部义警卡特·斯莱德，他后来被改名为幻影骑士——但布雷泽无疑是最具代表性的一位。他在1970年代拥有一套连载80期的个人漫画，此后始终是漫威宇宙的常驻角色，即便后来有其他恶灵骑士加入战局也未曾淡出。他还被改编进前述两部尼古拉斯·凯奇电影，并多次出现在漫威电子游戏中。

paragraphs.en: If you don’t know much about Johnny Blaze from the comics, the short version is that he’s a motorcycle stuntman who sold his soul to Satan (later retconned to be Mephisto ) in exchange for curing his mentor Crash Simpson of cancer, only for Crash to die in a stunt accident right after. When the devil came to collect, Blaze was saved by the love of his girlfriend Roxanne Simpson (Crash’s daughter) and bonded with a Spirit of Vengeance. Johnny got a flaming skull, a matching motorcycle, and even got to keep his soul, resulting in him using his demonic powers to enact Hell’s vengeance on evildoers who crossed his path.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你不太了解漫画中的约翰尼·布雷泽，简单来说，他是一名摩托车特技演员。为了治好导师克拉什·辛普森的癌症，他把灵魂卖给撒旦——后来设定改为墨菲斯托——结果克拉什不久后仍死于特技事故。恶魔前来收取代价时，布雷泽因女友罗克珊·辛普森（克拉什之女）的爱而获救，并与复仇之灵结合。约翰尼由此获得燃烧的骷髅头和配套摩托车，甚至保住了灵魂，开始用恶魔力量向沿途遇到的恶人施以地狱的复仇。

paragraphs.en: While Marvel could do a straightforward Johnny Blaze origin movie, that might feel a bit simplistic at this point in the MCU. He also doesn’t have the strongest rogues gallery, so it’s hard to say who would be the villain besides Mephisto (unless Feige is really into the Orb or Steel Wind). If they want to go outside the box, they could always adapt the story by Jenny Blake Isabella where Blaze gets help from Jesus Christ. Yes, that really happened, even if editor Jim Shooter rewrote the ending against Isabella’s wishes. However, pairing Johnny up with another hero would make sense, especially if it was…
paragraphs.cn: 漫威当然可以拍一部直截了当的约翰尼·布雷泽起源电影，但放在如今的MCU中，这或许显得过于简单。他的反派阵容也不算特别强大，因此除墨菲斯托外，很难判断谁能担任主要反派——除非费奇真的很喜欢Orb或Steel Wind。若想打破常规，漫威也可以改编编剧Jenny Blake Isabella创作的故事，让布雷泽得到耶稣基督相助。没错，这段情节真的发生过，尽管编辑Jim Shooter违背Isabella的意愿重写了结局。不过，让约翰尼与另一位英雄搭档会更合理，尤其当那个人是……

paragraphs.en: The next character to take up the Ghost Rider mantle was Daniel “Danny” Ketch, a teenager from Cypress Hills, New York, who debuted in 1990. While traveling to a graveyard alongside his sister Barbara, Danny wound up stumbling into a confrontation between rival gangs. Barbara was wounded in the crossfire, and while hiding with his unconscious sister, Danny discovered a motorcycle with a glowing gas cap. Upon touching it, he was imbued with the powers of the Ghost Rider and became the new Spirit of Vengeance. Barbara sadly didn’t survive after an encounter with the supernatural villain Blackout, who would become one of Danny’s greatest enemies.
paragraphs.cn: 下一位继承恶灵骑士称号的是丹尼尔「丹尼」·凯奇。这名来自纽约赛普拉斯山的少年于1990年首次登场。丹尼和姐姐芭芭拉前往墓地时，意外撞上敌对帮派的冲突。芭芭拉在交火中受伤；丹尼带着昏迷的姐姐躲藏时，发现一辆油箱盖发光的摩托车。他触碰摩托车后获得恶灵骑士之力，成为新的复仇之灵。遗憾的是，芭芭拉后来遭遇超自然反派Blackout，最终未能幸存；Blackout也成为丹尼最主要的宿敌之一。

paragraphs.en: Danny is a key possibility for the MCU because of his importance in the comics. Not only did his solo comic last longer than Johnny’s and was arguably more popular with readers, it also introduced crucial aspects of the Ghost Rider mythology, such as the Penance Stare, powerful villains like Blackout and Deathwatch, and the fact that the Rider’s power can be transferred to different individuals. But the biggest reason why we think Danny is on the MCU’s radar is because of the Ghost Rider and Blaze: Spirits of Vengeance comic, a series that featured Johnny and Danny working together. The pair would later be revealed as half-brothers and also serve as founding members of the Midnight Sons, a team of supernatural antiheroes who came together to battle Lilith, the Mother of Demons.
paragraphs.cn: 丹尼是MCU不容忽视的候选人，因为他在漫画中地位重要。他的个人漫画不仅比约翰尼的连载更久，甚至可以说更受读者欢迎，还引入了恶灵骑士神话中的关键要素，包括审判之眼、Blackout与Deathwatch等强敌，以及骑士之力可以转移给不同个体的设定。不过，我们认为MCU可能关注丹尼的最大原因，是漫画《Ghost Rider and Blaze: Spirits of Vengeance》。该系列让约翰尼与丹尼并肩作战；两人后来被揭示为同父异母的兄弟，也是午夜之子创始成员。这支超自然反英雄团队集结起来，对抗恶魔之母莉莉丝。

paragraphs.en: A Ghost Rider movie featuring Johnny and Danny as co-leads feels more likely than a solo origin film at this point in the MCU. Perhaps Gosling as Johnny will serve as the mentor figure to a younger actor playing Danny. And as Marvel prepares to establish a new saga after wrapping up the Multiverse Saga with Avengers: Doomsday and Secret Wars, laying the groundwork for a Midnight Sons crossover movie could be the connecting thread of the next wave of MCU films.
paragraphs.cn: 以目前的MCU阶段来看，让约翰尼和丹尼共同担任主角的《恶灵骑士》电影，似乎比单人起源片更有可能。高斯林或许会饰演约翰尼，担任年轻版丹尼的导师。漫威准备以《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》和《复仇者联盟：秘密战争》结束多元宇宙传奇后开启全新篇章，而为《午夜之子》联动电影铺路，可能正是下一波MCU影片的连接主线。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, with the Blade solo movie reportedly dead, reports indicate that Feige and his team are developing a Midnight Sons movie featuring Mahershala Ali as the character instead. Could Gosling's Ghost Rider movie be the first step to making that a reality?
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，据报道，随着《刀锋战士》个人电影告吹，费奇和团队正在转而开发一部《午夜之子》电影，并让马赫沙拉·阿里在片中饰演刀锋战士。高斯林的《恶灵骑士》会不会就是实现这一计划的第一步？

paragraphs.en: Of course, the elephant in the room is that there technically already is a Ghost Rider in the MCU: Robbie Reyes, played by Gabriel Luna, who appeared on Agents of SHIELD. That show has been ignored by the wider MCU (unfairly, in my opinion), but it did happen. Season 4 featured a brief appearance from Johnny Blaze, who passed on the Spirit of Vengeance to Robbie. Robbie went on to become a supporting character in the show. Is this event going to be retconned by the new film? Or will Robbie be acknowledged in some capacity?
paragraphs.cn: 当然，还有一个无法回避的问题：严格来说，MCU里已经有一位恶灵骑士——加布里埃尔·鲁纳在《神盾局特工》中饰演的罗比·雷耶斯。尽管整个MCU后来一直忽略这部剧（在笔者看来并不公平），但这些剧情确实发生过。第四季中，约翰尼·布雷泽短暂登场，并把复仇之灵传给罗比；罗比此后成为剧中配角。新电影会不会通过修改设定抹去这件事？还是会以某种方式承认罗比的存在？

paragraphs.en: The most likely outcome is that Secret Wars pulling a “reset” on the MCU timeline will allow Marvel to do whatever they please with Ghost Rider regardless of the show’s events, but given that Robbie is one of the few Latino superheroes in the Marvel universe, I believe it’s a mistake to throw him out entirely.
paragraphs.cn: 最可能的结果是，《秘密战争》会「重置」MCU时间线，让漫威得以不受剧集事件束缚，随意安排恶灵骑士。不过，罗比是漫威宇宙中为数不多的拉丁裔超级英雄之一，笔者认为彻底舍弃他会是一个错误。

paragraphs.en: And lastly, there’s Cosmic Ghost Rider. Now, this is almost certainly not the protagonist of the new film, but he’s worth a mention for how weird he is. Cosmic Ghost Rider is actually a variant of Frank Castle, aka the Punisher, who made a deal with Mephisto after his death and was later granted cosmic power by Galactus. Instead of fighting a war on criminals, Cosmic Ghost Rider’s mission was to avenge the murder of everyone on Earth by his universe’s version of Thanos. He would later cross between realities and meet characters from the 616 universe. As hilarious as it would be to see Ryan Gosling in Cosmic Ghost Rider’s costume (and how mad Jon Bernthal would presumably be), we’re fairly sure this particular hero isn’t riding into the MCU anytime soon. But who knows? Maybe by Phase 15, we’ll get to see Space Frank Castle in action.
paragraphs.cn: 最后还有宇宙恶灵骑士。他几乎肯定不是新片主角，但设定实在太离奇，值得一提。宇宙恶灵骑士其实是弗兰克·卡斯特——也就是惩罚者——的一个变体。他死后与墨菲斯托交易，随后又从行星吞噬者那里获得宇宙力量。宇宙恶灵骑士不再向罪犯开战，而是要为地球上所有被其宇宙版本灭霸杀害的人复仇。后来，他穿越不同现实，遇见616宇宙的角色。虽然想象瑞恩·高斯林穿上宇宙恶灵骑士服装十分有趣——乔·博恩瑟大概也会气坏——但我们相当确定，这位英雄近期不会骑进MCU。不过谁知道呢？说不定到了第15阶段，我们真能看到太空版弗兰克·卡斯特出场。

paragraphs.en: Who do you want to see as Ghost Rider in the MCU? Let us know in the comments and vote in our poll!
paragraphs.cn: 你希望在MCU中看到谁成为恶灵骑士？欢迎在评论区告诉我们，并参与投票！

summary: 漫威尚未公布瑞恩·高斯林饰演哪一版恶灵骑士。约翰尼·布雷泽最为知名，但丹尼·凯奇可为《午夜之子》铺路；《神盾局特工》的罗比·雷耶斯和宇宙恶灵骑士也让角色安排存在更多可能。
opus_summary: 高斯林最可能饰演约翰尼·布雷泽，却也可能与年轻版丹尼·凯奇组成双主角，为《午夜之子》铺路。《神盾局特工》的罗比·雷耶斯是否保留，则取决于《秘密战争》如何重置时间线。
